title: Zero Managed Allocations Per RunFrame Hot Path
body: Sustained managed C64 PAL RunFrame execution must avoid per-frame managed allocations so 50 Hz operation does not create GC pressure.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The measured C64 PAL RunFrame loop reports zero current-thread allocations over the measured frame window.
BenchmarkDotNet run reports no managed allocation for C64PalRunFrameBenchmark.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: BenchmarkDotNet C64PalRunFrameBenchmark: Allocated column reported no managed allocation
